mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening labor market and consumer demand, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the prior month indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a restrictive monetary policy coinciding with a weakening supply chain, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (index) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during post-recession recovery when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
